attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Wisconsin state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WI" streq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WI" streq and

action_details.action_postfix: "Wisconsin filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 (Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22 (Corporations, general provisions)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Department of Revenue Publication 112" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "Wisconsin filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Tax Bulletin 203 (July 2018) - Economic Nexus Guidance" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22(1r) (Definitions - doing business)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin nexus - no filing requirement." job.audit_trail swap addto "Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wisconsin state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /additions xdef
additions /apportionment.state_additions xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wisconsin state corporate income tax. Applies Wisconsin 7.9% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Wisconsin State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin tax with 7.9% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Wisconsin corporate income tax at 7.9% flat rate. Reference: WI Stat. 71.27" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability. Wisconsin NOL rules may apply. Reference: WI Stat. 71.26(4)" job.audit_trail swap addto
